"""Saved portfolio reporting cohorts on the original A/B source and request stores."""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3

from portfolio.storage import canonical, checked_id, digest, file_identity, now, require
from portfolio_target.target import TargetError

from .closure import SourceClosure, restore_sources
from .dataset import RowSummary, RelationalWriter, all_headers, export_query, query_page, quoted
from .delivery import ReceivedPackage, Sink, azure_sql, html_report, power_query, readme
from .measures import currency_context, measure_profile, project_measures
from .projection import FAMILIES, Projection, available_fields, data_dictionary, selected_fields

ACTIONS = frozenset({
    "archive_save", "archive_review", "archive_publish", "archive_query_export",
    "archive_inspect", "archive_receive",
})
PROJECT_KEY = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}\Z")


class ArchiveWorkspace:
    """A cohort index and immutable reports inside the existing operator workspace."""
    def __init__(self, portfolio, operator_store, *, stopped=None):
        self.portfolio, self.store = portfolio, operator_store
        self.root = portfolio.root
        self.stopped = stopped
        self._verified = {}

    def _put(self, value):
        return self.store.put_bytes(canonical(value))

    def _check_running(self):
        if self.stopped is not None and self.stopped():
            raise TargetError("ARCHIVE_CLOSING", "Reopen this saved archive request when the original desk is running.")

    def _index(self, identity):
        return self.store.index("cohorts", checked_id(identity))

    def list(self, *, cursor="", limit=25):
        page = self.store.list("cohorts", cursor=cursor, limit=limit)
        return {**page, "items": [{key: row.get(key) for key in (
            "id", "revision", "created_at", "updated_at", "name", "description", "definition_sha256",
            "review_sha256", "latest_publication", "member_count")} for row in page["items"]]}

    def read(self, identity):
        cohort = self._index(identity)
        definition = self.store.read(cohort["definition_sha256"])
        review = self.store.read(cohort["review_sha256"]) if cohort.get("review_sha256") else None
        return {"cohort": cohort, "definition": definition,
                "review": None if review is None else {"sha256": cohort["review_sha256"], "value": review},
                "publications": [self.store.read(item["sha256"]) for item in cohort.get("publications", [])],
                "query_exports": [self.store.read(item["sha256"]) for item in cohort.get("query_exports", [])]}

    def fields(self, edition_ids):
        require(isinstance(edition_ids, list) and 1 <= len(edition_ids) <= 500
                and len(set(edition_ids)) == len(edition_ids),
                "archive_edition_selection", "Select distinct exact source editions.")
        return available_fields(self.portfolio.read_edition(checked_id(identity)) for identity in edition_ids)

    def _definition(self, value):
        require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) <= {"name", "description", "members", "profile"},
                "archive_cohort", "Use the cohort name, original members and reporting profile.")
        name, description = value.get("name"), value.get("description", "")
        require(isinstance(name, str) and name.strip() and len(name) <= 240
                and isinstance(description, str) and len(description) <= 8000,
                "archive_name", "Name this reporting cohort and its business purpose.")
        requested = value.get("members")
        require(isinstance(requested, list) and 1 <= len(requested) <= 500,
                "archive_members", "Select 1 to 500 original project editions for this cohort.")
        keys, edition_ids, members = set(), set(), []
        for item in requested:
            require(isinstance(item, dict) and set(item) <= {"project_key", "label", "edition_id", "currency"},
                    "archive_member", "Keep each project's key, label, exact edition and optional currency declaration.")
            key, label = item.get("project_key"), item.get("label")
            require(isinstance(key, str) and PROJECT_KEY.fullmatch(key) and key not in keys,
                    "archive_project_key", "Give each business project one distinct reporting key.")
            require(isinstance(label, str) and label.strip() and len(label) <= 240,
                    "archive_project_label", "Name each selected business project.")
            eid = checked_id(item.get("edition_id"))
            require(eid not in edition_ids, "archive_duplicate_edition",
                    "Select the original edition once in this cohort; one snapshot cannot represent two projects.")
            edition = self.portfolio.read_edition(eid)
            model = edition["model"]
            require(model.get("schema") == "project-portfolio-model.v1",
                    "archive_model", "Select a complete original native portfolio edition.")
            member = {"project_key": key, "label": label, "edition_id": eid,
                      "model_sha256": edition["sha256"], "kind": edition["kind"],
                      "source_ids": edition["source_ids"]}
            if "currency" in item:
                member["currency"] = copy.deepcopy(item["currency"])
            currency_context(member, model)
            members.append(member)
            keys.add(key)
            edition_ids.add(eid)
        coverage = available_fields(self.portfolio.read_edition(member["edition_id"]) for member in members)
        profile = value.get("profile") or {}
        require(isinstance(profile, dict) and set(profile) <= {"columns", "metrics"},
                "archive_profile", "Select original report columns and exact-grain metrics.")
        columns = selected_fields({"columns": profile["columns"]} if "columns" in profile else {}, coverage)
        normalized = {**columns, "metrics": measure_profile(profile.get("metrics"), coverage)}
        return {"schema": "portfolio.archive-definition.v1", "name": name, "description": description,
                "members": members, "profile": normalized}

    def _selected(self, definition):
        seen = set()
        for member in definition["members"]:
            self._check_running()
            require(member["edition_id"] not in seen, "archive_duplicate_edition", "The original cohort contains repeated editions.")
            seen.add(member["edition_id"])
            edition = self.portfolio.read_edition(member["edition_id"])
            require(edition["sha256"] == member["model_sha256"] and edition["source_ids"] == member["source_ids"],
                    "archive_edition_changed", "The selected original edition differs from the saved cohort.")
            yield member, edition

    def _existing(self, identity):
        try:
            return self._index(identity)
        except TargetError as error:
            if error.code != "OPERATOR_NOT_FOUND":
                raise
            return None

    def _replay(self, cohort, request_id, kind, arguments):
        selected = cohort.get("mutations", {}).get(request_id)
        if selected is None:
            return None
        result = self.store.read(selected)
        require(result.get("request_id") == request_id and result.get("kind") == kind
                and result.get("input_sha256") == digest(arguments),
                "archive_request_reused", "The original saved cohort mutation has different input.")
        return result

    def _commit(self, cohort, request_id, kind, arguments, details):
        previous = self._replay(cohort, request_id, kind, arguments)
        if previous is not None:
            return previous
        result = {"schema": "portfolio.archive-action.v1", "request_id": request_id, "kind": kind,
                  "input_sha256": digest(arguments), "cohort_id": cohort["id"],
                  "cohort_revision": cohort.get("revision", 0) + 1, **details}
        ref = self._put(result)
        cohort.setdefault("mutations", {})[request_id] = ref["sha256"]
        self.store.save("cohorts", cohort, expected_revision=cohort.get("revision", 0))
        return result

    def run(self, request_id, kind, arguments):
        with self.store.locked():
            return self._run_locked(request_id, kind, arguments)

    def _run_locked(self, request_id, kind, arguments):
        """Called under the original B lock; A supplies its existing durable operation."""
        checked_id(request_id)
        require(kind in ACTIONS and isinstance(arguments, dict),
                "archive_action", "Select an original archive action and its saved arguments.")
        with self.portfolio.store.operation(request_id, kind, arguments) as operation:
            completed = operation.result()
            if completed is not None:
                return completed
            self._check_running()
            if kind == "archive_save":
                result = self._save(request_id, arguments)
            elif kind == "archive_review":
                result = self._review(request_id, arguments, operation)
            elif kind == "archive_publish":
                result = self._publish(request_id, arguments, operation)
            elif kind == "archive_query_export":
                result = self._query_export(request_id, arguments, operation)
            elif kind == "archive_inspect":
                result = self._inspect(arguments)
            else:
                result = self._receive(request_id, arguments, operation)
            return operation.complete(result)

    def _save(self, request_id, args):
        require(set(args) <= {"cohort_id", "expected_revision", "name", "description", "members", "profile"},
                "archive_save", "Save the original cohort fields and expected revision.")
        identity = checked_id(args.get("cohort_id", request_id))
        cohort = self._existing(identity)
        if cohort is not None:
            replay = self._replay(cohort, request_id, "archive_save", args)
            if replay is not None:
                return replay
        else:
            require(identity == request_id, "archive_new_identity", "Create the cohort with its original request identity.")
            cohort = {"schema": "portfolio.archive-cohort.v1", "id": identity, "revision": 0,
                      "created_at": now(), "publications": [], "query_exports": [], "mutations": {}}
        if args.get("expected_revision", 0) != cohort["revision"]:
            raise TargetError("STALE_REVISION", "Reopen the saved cohort before replacing its selected project editions.")
        definition = self._definition({key: args[key] for key in ("name", "description", "members", "profile") if key in args})
        ref = self._put(definition)
        cohort.update(name=definition["name"], description=definition["description"],
                      member_count=len(definition["members"]), definition_sha256=ref["sha256"])
        cohort.pop("review_sha256", None)
        return self._commit(cohort, request_id, "archive_save", args, {"definition_sha256": ref["sha256"]})

    def _summary(self, definition):
        profile = definition["profile"]
        summary = RowSummary(all_headers(profile))
        projection = Projection(profile, summary.emit)
        findings, totals = [], []
        for member, edition in self._selected(definition):
            projection.member(member, edition)
            current, _, errors = project_measures(member, edition, profile["metrics"],
                                                  emit=lambda row: summary.emit("measure_contributions", row))
            for row in current:
                summary.emit("measure_totals", row)
            totals.extend(current)
            common = {"project_key": member["project_key"], "edition_id": edition["id"]}
            for finding in errors:
                projection.finding(common, finding, "reporting")
            findings.extend({**common, **row} for row in edition.get("findings", []))
            findings.extend({**common, **row} for row in errors)
        findings.extend(projection.relationship_findings)
        coverage = available_fields(edition for _, edition in self._selected(definition))
        selected = {family: set(profile["columns"].get(family, [])) for family in FAMILIES}
        metric_family = "tasks" if profile["metrics"]["grain"] == "leaf_tasks" else profile["metrics"]["grain"]
        selected[metric_family].update(item["field"] for item in profile["metrics"]["measures"])
        for family, fields in coverage.items():
            for info in fields:
                if info["field"] in selected[family] and len(info["definitions"]) > 1:
                    finding = {"code": "archive_definition_variation", "severity": "review",
                               "message": "This selected native field has different definitions in the cohort.",
                               "details": {"family": family, "field": info["field"],
                                           "editions": info["editions"], "definitions": info["definitions"]}}
                    selected_finding = {"id": digest(finding), **finding}
                    findings.append(selected_finding)
                    projection.finding({"project_key": None, "edition_id": None}, selected_finding, "reporting")
        return {**summary.value(), "findings": findings, "measure_totals": totals, "field_coverage": coverage}

    def _review(self, request_id, args, operation):
        require(set(args) == {"cohort_id", "expected_revision"}, "archive_review", "Review the current saved cohort revision.")
        cohort = self._index(args["cohort_id"])
        replay = self._replay(cohort, request_id, "archive_review", args)
        if replay is not None:
            return replay
        if args["expected_revision"] != cohort["revision"]:
            raise TargetError("STALE_REVISION", "Reopen the selected cohort before reviewing its reporting projection.")
        selected = operation.phase("review")
        if selected is None:
            definition = self.store.read(cohort["definition_sha256"])
            review = {"schema": "portfolio.archive-review.v1", "cohort_id": cohort["id"],
                      "cohort_revision": cohort["revision"] + 1, "definition_sha256": cohort["definition_sha256"],
                      "name": definition["name"], "description": definition["description"],
                      "members": definition["members"], "profile": definition["profile"],
                      "projection": "portfolio.archive-projection.v1", "created_at": now(),
                      **self._summary(definition)}
            ref = self._put(review)
            selected = operation.checkpoint("review", {"sha256": ref["sha256"]})
        review = self.store.read(selected["sha256"])
        require(review["definition_sha256"] == cohort["definition_sha256"]
                and review["cohort_revision"] == cohort["revision"] + 1,
                "archive_review_changed", "Retain the exact original cohort revision for this review.")
        cohort["review_sha256"] = selected["sha256"]
        return self._commit(cohort, request_id, "archive_review", args, {"review_sha256": selected["sha256"]})

    def _stage(self, request_id):
        path = self.root.parent / (self.root.name + "-operator-deliveries") / "archive-builds" / checked_id(request_id)
        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
        return path

    def _retain(self, path, filename, **metadata):
        actual = file_identity(path)
        self.store.retain_file(path, actual["sha256"], actual["bytes"])
        return {**actual, "filename": filename, **metadata}

    def _publish(self, request_id, args, operation):
        require(set(args) == {"cohort_id", "expected_revision", "review_sha256", "reviewer", "note"},
                "archive_publish", "Publish the exact saved review with its named operator and decision.")
        cohort = self._index(args["cohort_id"])
        replay = self._replay(cohort, request_id, "archive_publish", args)
        if replay is not None:
            return replay
        saved = operation.phase("publication")
        if saved is None:
            if args["expected_revision"] != cohort["revision"]:
                raise TargetError("STALE_REVISION", "Reopen the current reviewed archive before publishing it.")
            require(cohort.get("review_sha256") == args["review_sha256"],
                    "archive_review_changed", "Choose the exact saved reporting review.")
            review = self.store.read(checked_id(args["review_sha256"]))
            require(review["cohort_id"] == cohort["id"] and review["definition_sha256"] == cohort["definition_sha256"]
                    and review["cohort_revision"] == cohort["revision"],
                    "archive_review_binding", "The selected review belongs to another cohort revision.")
            require(isinstance(args["reviewer"], str) and args["reviewer"].strip()
                    and isinstance(args["note"], str) and args["note"].strip(),
                    "archive_reviewer", "Record the archive operator and the concrete delivery decision.")
            approval = operation.phase("approval")
            if approval is None:
                approval = operation.checkpoint("approval", {"request_id": request_id, "reviewer": args["reviewer"],
                                                             "note": args["note"], "at": now(),
                                                             "review_sha256": args["review_sha256"]})
            stage, definition = self._stage(request_id), self.store.read(cohort["definition_sha256"])
            sink = Sink(stage / "payload")
            closure = SourceClosure(self.portfolio, self.store, sink)
            writer = RelationalWriter(stage / "derived", definition["profile"])
            projection = Projection(definition["profile"], writer.emit)
            totals = []
            try:
                for member, edition in self._selected(definition):
                    closure.edition(edition["id"])
                    projection.member(member, edition)
                    current, _, errors = project_measures(member, edition, definition["profile"]["metrics"],
                        emit=lambda row: writer.emit("measure_contributions", row))
                    for row in current:
                        writer.emit("measure_totals", row)
                    totals.extend(current)
                    for finding in errors:
                        projection.finding({"project_key": member["project_key"], "edition_id": edition["id"]}, finding, "reporting")
                for finding in review["findings"]:
                    if finding.get("code") == "archive_definition_variation" and "project_key" not in finding:
                        projection.finding({"project_key": None, "edition_id": None}, finding, "reporting")
                dataset = writer.finish(sink)
            finally:
                writer.close()
            require(dataset["tables"] == review["tables"] and dataset["table_sha256"] == review["table_sha256"]
                    and dataset["columns"] == review["columns"] and totals == review["measure_totals"],
                    "archive_projection_changed", "The current projection differs from the operator's exact saved review.")
            sink.add_bytes("cohort.json", canonical(definition), role="cohort_definition")
            sink.add_bytes("data-dictionary.json", canonical(data_dictionary(definition["profile"], dataset["columns"])), role="data_dictionary")
            sink.add_bytes("power-query.m", power_query(dataset["columns"]).encode("utf-8"), role="power_query")
            sink.add_bytes("azure-sql.sql", azure_sql(dataset["columns"]).encode("utf-8"), role="azure_sql")
            sink.add_bytes("README.md", readme(review).encode("utf-8"), role="operating_guide")
            sink.add_bytes("report.html", html_report(review, approval, dataset["tables"], totals).encode("utf-8"), role="report")
            package = sink.package(review, args["review_sha256"], approval, stage / "portfolio-archive.zip")
            artifacts = []
            for item in sorted(sink.files.values(), key=lambda value: value["path"]):
                if item["role"] in {"relational_database", "table_csv", "data_dictionary", "power_query",
                                    "azure_sql", "operating_guide", "report", "manifest"}:
                    artifacts.append(self._retain(sink.destination(item["path"]), Path(item["path"]).name,
                                                  role=item["role"], package_path=item["path"],
                                                  **{key: item[key] for key in ("table", "rows") if key in item}))
            archive = self._retain(package["path"], "portfolio-archive-" + cohort["id"][:12] + ".zip", role="archive")
            publication = {"schema": "portfolio.archive-publication.v1", "id": request_id,
                           "cohort_id": cohort["id"], "definition_sha256": cohort["definition_sha256"],
                           "review_sha256": args["review_sha256"], "approval": approval,
                           "created_at": approval["at"], "dataset": dataset, "source_closure": closure.summary(),
                           "manifest_sha256": package["manifest_sha256"], "file_count": package["file_count"],
                           "artifacts": artifacts, "archive": archive}
            ref = self._put(publication)
            saved = operation.checkpoint("publication", {"sha256": ref["sha256"], "id": request_id})
        publication = self.store.read(saved["sha256"])
        cohort.setdefault("publications", []).append({"id": request_id, "sha256": saved["sha256"], "created_at": publication["created_at"]})
        if cohort["definition_sha256"] == publication["definition_sha256"]:
            cohort["latest_publication"] = request_id
        result = self._commit(cohort, request_id, "archive_publish", args,
                              {"publication_id": request_id, "publication_sha256": saved["sha256"],
                               "archive": publication["archive"], "artifacts": publication["artifacts"]})
        # Exact completed artifact objects are retained in the original workspace;
        # their disposable hardlinked construction tree is no longer needed.
        shutil.rmtree(self._stage(request_id), ignore_errors=True)
        return result

    def publication(self, cohort_id, publication_id):
        cohort = self._index(cohort_id)
        selected = [item for item in cohort.get("publications", []) if item["id"] == checked_id(publication_id)]
        require(len(selected) == 1, "archive_publication", "Select one retained publication from this original cohort.")
        publication = self.store.read(selected[0]["sha256"])
        require(publication["id"] == publication_id, "archive_publication_identity", "The original publication identity changed.")
        return publication

    def _artifact_path(self, artifact):
        path = self.store.root / "objects" / checked_id(artifact["sha256"])
        before = path.stat()
        identity = (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns)
        if self._verified.get(artifact["sha256"]) != identity:
            require(file_identity(path) == {"sha256": artifact["sha256"], "bytes": artifact["bytes"]},
                    "archive_artifact_changed", "A retained complete reporting artifact changed.")
            self._verified[artifact["sha256"]] = identity
        return path

    def _database(self, publication):
        selected = [item for item in publication["artifacts"] if item["role"] == "relational_database"]
        require(len(selected) == 1, "archive_database", "Retain the one original reporting database.")
        return self._artifact_path(selected[0])

    def table(self, cohort_id, publication_id, table, *, offset=0, limit=50, filter_column=None, filter_text=""):
        publication = self.publication(cohort_id, publication_id)
        headers, counts = publication["dataset"]["columns"], publication["dataset"]["tables"]
        require(table in headers and type(offset) is int and offset >= 0 and type(limit) is int and 1 <= limit <= 250,
                "archive_table_page", "Select an original table and a page of 1 to 250 rows.")
        require(filter_column is None or filter_column in headers[table],
                "archive_table_filter", "Filter a column from this exact original table.")
        require(isinstance(filter_text, str) and len(filter_text) <= 2000,
                "archive_filter_text", "Use a text filter up to 2,000 characters.")
        where = "" if filter_column is None or not filter_text else " WHERE instr(" + quoted(filter_column) + ", ?) > 0"
        params = [] if not where else [filter_text]
        sql = "SELECT * FROM " + quoted(table) + where + " ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ? OFFSET ?"
        result = query_page(self._database(publication), headers, sql, params + [str(limit + 1), str(offset)],
                            limit=limit, stopped=self.stopped)
        return {**result, "table": table, "offset": offset, "unfiltered_rows": counts[table],
                "next_offset": offset + len(result["rows"]) if result["has_more"] else None}

    def query(self, cohort_id, publication_id, sql, parameters=None, *, limit=100):
        publication = self.publication(cohort_id, publication_id)
        return query_page(self._database(publication), publication["dataset"]["columns"], sql, parameters,
                          limit=limit, stopped=self.stopped)

    def _query_export(self, request_id, args, operation):
        require(set(args) == {"cohort_id", "publication_id", "sql", "parameters"},
                "archive_query_export", "Save the selected publication, complete SQL and exact text parameters.")
        cohort = self._index(args["cohort_id"])
        replay = self._replay(cohort, request_id, "archive_query_export", args)
        if replay is not None:
            return replay
        saved = operation.phase("query_export")
        if saved is None:
            publication = self.publication(cohort["id"], args["publication_id"])
            result = export_query(self._database(publication), publication["dataset"]["columns"],
                                  args["sql"], args["parameters"], self._stage(request_id) / "query.csv", stopped=self.stopped)
            artifact = self._retain(result["path"], "portfolio-query-" + request_id[:12] + ".csv", role="query_csv")
            value = {"schema": "portfolio.archive-query.v1", "id": request_id, "cohort_id": cohort["id"],
                     "publication_id": publication["id"], "database_sha256": next(
                         item["sha256"] for item in publication["artifacts"] if item["role"] == "relational_database"),
                     "sql": args["sql"], "parameters": args["parameters"], "rows": result["rows"],
                     "columns": result["columns"], "created_at": now(), "artifact": artifact}
            ref = self._put(value)
            saved = operation.checkpoint("query_export", {"sha256": ref["sha256"]})
        value = self.store.read(saved["sha256"])
        cohort.setdefault("query_exports", []).append({"id": request_id, "sha256": saved["sha256"], "created_at": value["created_at"]})
        result = self._commit(cohort, request_id, "archive_query_export", args,
                              {"query_sha256": saved["sha256"], "artifact": value["artifact"], "rows": value["rows"]})
        shutil.rmtree(self._stage(request_id), ignore_errors=True)
        return result

    def _inspect(self, args):
        require(set(args) == {"source"}, "archive_inspect", "Inspect the original complete uploaded archive.")
        source = self.store.selected_upload(args["source"])
        with ReceivedPackage(source) as received:
            manifest = received.manifest
            return {"schema": "portfolio.archive-inspection.v1", "source": args["source"],
                    "archive": received.identity, "manifest_sha256": received.manifest_sha256,
                    "review_sha256": manifest["review_sha256"], "review": manifest["review"],
                    "approval": manifest["approval"], "file_count": len(manifest["files"]) + 1}

    def _check_database(self, path, review):
        require(review["columns"] == all_headers(review["profile"]), "archive_database_profile",
                "The original database columns differ from the selected reporting profile.")
        summary = RowSummary(review["columns"])
        connection = sqlite3.connect(Path(path).resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro&immutable=1", uri=True)
        try:
            require(connection.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchall() == [("ok",)],
                    "archive_database_integrity", "The received original reporting database failed its integrity check.")
            tables = connection.execute("SELECT name,type FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'").fetchall()
            require({name for name, kind in tables if kind == "table"} == set(review["columns"])
                    and all(kind in {"table", "index"} for _, kind in tables),
                    "archive_database_schema", "The archive database has different report tables or executable schema.")
            for table, columns in review["columns"].items():
                actual = connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(" + quoted(table) + ")").fetchall()
                require([item[1] for item in actual] == columns and all(item[2].upper() == "TEXT" for item in actual),
                        "archive_database_columns", "The original report column schema changed.", table)
                require(connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM " + quoted(table)).fetchone()[0] == review["tables"][table],
                        "archive_database_rows", "The original report table row count changed.", table)
                cursor = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM " + quoted(table) + " ORDER BY rowid")
                for row in cursor:
                    summary.emit(table, dict(zip(columns, row)))
            require(summary.value()["table_sha256"] == review["table_sha256"], "archive_database_projection",
                    "The received complete relational rows differ from the exact reviewed projection.")
        finally:
            connection.close()

    def _receive(self, request_id, args, operation):
        require(set(args) == {"source", "manifest_sha256", "reviewer", "note"},
                "archive_receive", "Receive the exact inspected archive with its reviewing operator and note.")
        current = self._existing(request_id)
        if current is not None:
            replay = self._replay(current, request_id, "archive_receive", args)
            if replay is not None:
                return replay
        require(isinstance(args["reviewer"], str) and args["reviewer"].strip()
                and isinstance(args["note"], str) and args["note"].strip(),
                "archive_receiving_operator", "Name the receiving operator and the original delivery decision.")
        source = self.store.selected_upload(args["source"])
        stage = self._stage(request_id)
        with ReceivedPackage(source) as received:
            manifest, review = received.manifest, received.manifest["review"]
            require(received.manifest_sha256 == checked_id(args["manifest_sha256"]),
                    "archive_receiving_review", "Receive the original exact inspected manifest.")
            database_member = [item for item in manifest["files"] if item.get("role") == "relational_database"]
            require(len(database_member) == 1, "archive_database", "Receive the one original reporting database.")
            database_path = received.materialize(database_member[0]["path"], stage / "portfolio.sqlite")
            self._check_database(database_path, review)
            restored = restore_sources(self.portfolio, self.store, manifest, received.bytes,
                                       lambda name: received.staged_member(name, stage / "source-objects" / name))
            requested = {"name": review["name"], "description": review["description"],
                         "members": [{key: member[key] for key in ("project_key", "label", "edition_id", "currency") if key in member}
                                     for member in review["members"]], "profile": review["profile"]}
            definition = self._definition(requested)
            require(definition["members"] == review["members"] and definition["profile"] == review["profile"],
                    "archive_received_definition", "The received original projects or reporting definitions differ.")
            definition_ref = self._put(definition)
            require(definition_ref["sha256"] == review["definition_sha256"],
                    "archive_received_definition_hash", "The restored source cohort differs from its original reviewed definition.")
            recalculated = self._summary(definition)
            require(all(recalculated[key] == review[key] for key in
                        ("tables", "table_sha256", "columns", "measure_totals")),
                    "archive_received_source_projection", "The reporting database differs from the complete restored native source projection.")
            self._put(review)
            artifacts = []
            for item in manifest["files"]:
                if item["role"] in {"relational_database", "table_csv", "data_dictionary", "power_query",
                                    "azure_sql", "operating_guide", "report"}:
                    path = received.materialize(item["path"], stage / "artifacts" / item["path"])
                    artifacts.append(self._retain(path, Path(item["path"]).name, role=item["role"], package_path=item["path"],
                                                  **{key: item[key] for key in ("table", "rows") if key in item}))
            manifest_ref = self.store.put_bytes(canonical(manifest))
            artifacts.append({**manifest_ref, "filename": "manifest.json", "role": "manifest", "package_path": "manifest.json"})
            archive_ref = self._retain(source, "portfolio-archive-" + request_id[:12] + ".zip", role="archive")
            original_id = checked_id(manifest["approval"]["request_id"])
            saved_at = operation.phase("received_at") or operation.checkpoint("received_at", {"at": now()})
            publication = {"schema": "portfolio.archive-publication.v1", "id": original_id,
                           "cohort_id": request_id, "source_cohort_id": review["cohort_id"],
                           "definition_sha256": definition_ref["sha256"], "review_sha256": manifest["review_sha256"],
                           "approval": manifest["approval"], "created_at": manifest["approval"]["at"],
                           "dataset": {key: review[key] for key in ("tables", "table_sha256", "columns")},
                           "source_closure": restored, "manifest_sha256": received.manifest_sha256,
                           "file_count": len(manifest["files"]) + 1, "artifacts": artifacts, "archive": archive_ref,
                           "receiving": {"request_id": request_id, "reviewer": args["reviewer"], "note": args["note"], "at": saved_at["at"]}}
            publication_ref = self._put(publication)
        cohort = {"schema": "portfolio.archive-cohort.v1", "id": request_id, "revision": 0, "created_at": saved_at["at"],
                  "name": definition["name"], "description": definition["description"], "member_count": len(definition["members"]),
                  "definition_sha256": definition_ref["sha256"], "mutations": {}, "query_exports": [],
                  "latest_publication": original_id,
                  "publications": [{"id": original_id, "sha256": publication_ref["sha256"], "created_at": publication["created_at"]}],
                  "received_from": {"cohort_id": review["cohort_id"], "archive_sha256": archive_ref["sha256"],
                                    "manifest_sha256": args["manifest_sha256"]}}
        result = self._commit(cohort, request_id, "archive_receive", args,
                              {"publication_id": original_id, "publication_sha256": publication_ref["sha256"],
                               "restored": restored, "archive": archive_ref})
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
        return result

"""Run the whole native source/round-trip/receiving flow on pinned MPXJ fixtures."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from decimal import Decimal
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from portfolio import PortfolioWorkspace
from portfolio.storage import atomic_json, canonical, file_identity, read_json, require

UPSTREAM = "7ef9e72813d33378c55ec6ceb148cc831ed22033"
FIXTURES = [
    {"path": "junit/data/timephased-budget-baseline.mpp", "blob": "f4d2dcb2b74a829a6368d106a55e68712f417c68", "bytes": 354304},
    {"path": "junit/data/calendar-exception-precedence-daily.mpp", "blob": "77e7036f04f3cc582c61438c0deee30834d4d3b1", "bytes": 240640},
    {"path": "junit/data/generated/assignment-assignments/assignment-assignments-project2019-mspdi.xml", "blob": "229c381968ee1b23d2027a20eff0983dab3e855b", "bytes": 38478},
    {"path": "junit/data/baselines.xml", "blob": "f2b689d213abc719d55394f476c329634fc47517", "bytes": 24522},
    {"path": "junit/data/enterprise.xml", "blob": "11d5ddf8e3b799a655000890612e623ad9f935df", "bytes": 46339},
]


def run(upstream, directory):
    upstream, directory = Path(upstream).absolute(), Path(directory).absolute()
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    result_path = directory / "result.json"
    if result_path.exists():
        result = read_json(result_path)
        require(file_identity(result["archive"]["path"]) == {k: result["archive"][k] for k in ("sha256", "bytes")},
                "receiving_archive_changed", "The completed receiving archive changed.")
        restored = PortfolioWorkspace(result["receiving"]["destination"])
        for row in result["sources"]:
            require(restored.read_edition(row["edition_id"])["sha256"] == row["model_sha256"],
                    "receiving_edition_changed", "A received original native model changed.")
        return result
    ws = PortfolioWorkspace(directory / "workspace")
    runtime = ws.native.ensure()
    atomic_json(directory / "native-runtime.json", runtime, immutable=True)
    selected, captures = [], []
    for fixture in FIXTURES:
        path = upstream / fixture["path"]
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
        require(len(raw) == fixture["bytes"] and blob == fixture["blob"],
                "upstream_fixture_changed", "Use the unchanged fixture from the pinned maintained engine.", fixture)
        original = {"path": fixture["path"], "upstream_commit": UPSTREAM, "git_blob": blob, **file_identity(path)}
        selected.append(original)
        request = "native-intake-" + blob
        edition = ws.intake(request, path, label=Path(fixture["path"]).name)
        # Reopen the exact completed original request; this must not create another edition.
        reopened = ws.intake(request, path, label=Path(fixture["path"]).name)
        require(reopened["id"] == edition["id"], "intake_replay", "A repeated original intake must reopen its recorded edition.")
        export = ws.export_mspdi("native-export-" + blob, edition["id"])
        repeated = ws.export_mspdi("native-export-" + blob, edition["id"])
        require(repeated["id"] == export["id"] and repeated["sha256"] == export["sha256"],
                "export_replay", "A repeated native export must reopen the original bytes.")
        comparison = ws.store.record("comparisons", export["comparison_id"])
        captures.append({"fixture": original, "edition_id": edition["id"], "model_sha256": edition["sha256"],
                         "counts": edition["model"]["counts"], "findings": edition["findings"],
                         "native_export": export, "comparison": comparison})
    atomic_json(directory / "original-fixtures.json", selected, immutable=True)
    original = ws.read_edition(captures[2]["edition_id"])
    target = next(row for row in original["model"]["tasks"]
                  if row["uid"] not in (None, "0") and row["fields"].get("NAME", {}).get("type") == "string")
    correction = {"family": "tasks", "key": target["key"], "field": "NAME",
                  "before": target["fields"]["NAME"],
                  "after": {"type": "string", "value": target["fields"]["NAME"]["value"] + " — native receiving correction"}}
    corrections = [correction]
    fixed_cost = target["fields"].get("FIXED_COST")
    if fixed_cost and fixed_cost["type"] in {"number", "integer"}:
        corrections.append({"family": "tasks", "key": target["key"], "field": "FIXED_COST",
                            "before": fixed_cost, "after": {"type": "number",
                            "value": str(Decimal(fixed_cost["value"]) + Decimal("17.125"))}})
    review = ws.review(original["id"], target_profile={"kind": "mspdi"}, corrections=corrections)
    require(review["ready"], "native_review", "The selected original file correction must be ready.", review["unresolved"])
    changed = ws.apply_review("native-reviewed-correction", review["id"])
    corrected_output = ws.export_mspdi("native-corrected-output", changed["edition_id"])
    returned = ws.read_edition(corrected_output["native_readback_edition_id"])
    changed_row = next(row for row in returned["model"]["tasks"] if row["uid"] == target["uid"])
    require(changed_row["fields"]["NAME"]["value"] == correction["after"]["value"],
            "native_name_roundtrip", "The original native correction must survive actual MSPDI readback.")
    # A full archive is an original source/model/history delivery, including
    # features which the native file format itself cannot carry.
    archive = ws.export_workspace(directory / "portfolio-workspace.zip")
    received = PortfolioWorkspace.receive_workspace(archive["path"], directory / "received")
    restored = PortfolioWorkspace(received["destination"])
    require(restored.read_edition(changed["edition_id"])["sha256"] == changed["edition"]["sha256"],
            "native_receiving_model", "The received corrected native model must retain its complete original identity.")
    restored_export = restored.export_mspdi("native-corrected-output", changed["edition_id"])
    require(restored_export["sha256"] == corrected_output["sha256"]
            and Path(restored_export["path"]).is_relative_to(restored.root),
            "native_receiving_export", "The original export must reopen from the received workspace.")
    result = {"schema": "project-portfolio-native-receiving.v1", "state": "complete", "runtime": runtime,
              "sources": captures, "review_id": review["id"], "corrected_edition_id": changed["edition_id"],
              "corrections": corrections, "corrected_export": corrected_output,
              "archive": archive, "receiving": received,
              "source_workspace": str(ws.root), "restored_export_path": restored_export["path"]}
    atomic_json(result_path, result, immutable=True)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--upstream", required=True, help="Pinned original MPXJ checkout or unchanged fixture root")
    parser.add_argument("--directory", required=True, help="Original receiving operation directory; reuse to reopen")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = run(args.upstream, args.directory)
    print(json.dumps({"state": result["state"], "result": str(Path(args.directory).absolute() / "result.json"),
                      "source_workspace": result["source_workspace"], "receiving": result["receiving"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Portfolio target scheduling and acceptance

This operator completes the receiving side of the original portfolio migration workspace: retain a project, review source corrections, prepare a receiving plan, execute the selected native target, compare the actual received project, and save acceptance with a complete portable handover.

It uses the sibling `portfolio` package for every MPXJ read, typed source edition, correction, comparison, Microsoft Project XML export and workspace archive. Source files, native JSON and their original identity remain available throughout the operation.

The receiving comparison retains both entity changes and the original `definition_changes` from the field catalogue and native JSON collections. The browser pages through every definition change and shows both source identities; the HTML and JSON handover include the full original values, paths and hashes. Building or reopening that handover preserves the accepted comparison and acceptance SHA-256.

## Open the complete product

Run these commands from `services/project-portfolio-migration` after installing the original MPXJ runtime described in the product README:

```sh
python operator/serve.py \
  --workspace /absolute/customer/portfolio-workspace \
  --entry-file /absolute/private/portfolio-entry.json \
  --port 8857
```

Open the private URL in the entry file. The browser provides:

1. **Source:** original file and companion intake, saved editions, complete paginated native row families, typed field inspection, reviewed source corrections and native Project XML export.
2. **Target & mappings:** locally selected receiving profile, actual user/environment and native capability read, editable task field conversions, dependency choices, resource-to-team selections and a complete saved target plan.
3. **Review & execution:** actual transaction boundaries, retained-source decisions, named review, native operation continuation, pause before the next call, exact original reply recovery and abandonment of one unexecuted native set.
4. **Receiving & handover:** actual native target capture or returned project-file intake, original source/target comparison including native field and collection definitions, named acceptance, complete HTML/JSON handover and portable workspace.
5. **Activity:** every saved local action and its original input, result and same-request resume.

The default receiving profile is **Microsoft Project XML**. Cloud scheduling is available when an operator supplies a current private Project Operations profile. A file handover and a native cloud migration remain distinct saved operations.

## Source and file handover

Select the original project file and all companion files required by its native reader. The browser stores the complete uploaded bytes before asking the original source engine to read them. A selected source edition is immutable.

The field inspector shows each row's exact source key, native UID/GUID, typed getter fields and cached fields. A correction stores `family`, `key`, `field`, the exact typed `before` value and the proposed typed `after` value. The original source review decides whether that native field and change are supported. Applying the saved review creates a following source edition.

For the file target:

1. Select the source edition and **Microsoft Project XML**.
2. Prepare the complete file plan with explicit export options.
3. Review the original source findings and save the receiving operator's decision.
4. Continue the saved plan. This applies the original source review and invokes the original MPXJ `MSPDIWriter`.
5. Download `project-<edition>.xml` from the retained native export.
6. Import it into the receiving application that accepts Microsoft Project XML.
7. Upload the actual project file returned by that application. The same native source reader creates the received edition.
8. Review the source/target comparison, record accepted differences, and generate the handover.

The default export profile is:

```json
{
  "write_timephased": true,
  "microsoft_compatible": true,
  "save_version": "Project2016"
}
```

The selected options and the writer's native readback are part of the original source export. The original full source also carries calendars, custom fields, currency/rate data and other native collections that a receiving format may represent differently. Those differences are evaluated against the actual returned project.

MPXJ reads native MPP and writes MSPDI XML. This workflow does not rename XML bytes to an MPP filename. Microsoft documents its own Planner MPP import separately; the cloud path below uses the native scheduling API.

## Configure the native Project Operations target

Keep the target configuration and delegated access-token file **outside** the portable workspace. Copy `examples/target-profiles.json`, replace its example selections with the actual environment/user/organization, and restrict the token file to its owner.

```sh
chmod 600 /absolute/private/project-user-token.json
python operator/serve.py \
  --workspace /absolute/customer/portfolio-workspace \
  --profiles /absolute/private/target-profiles.json \
  --entry-file /absolute/private/portfolio-entry.json \
  --port 8857
```

The selected environment must expose the documented Project scheduling actions. Microsoft requires a licensed Project user for these APIs; the native probe verifies the actual delegated user and organization, active non-application user record, complete native CSDL and actual OperationSet and dependency choices. The private profile identifies the intended user. The native service retains its own licensing and authorization checks.

A token file may contain the exact access token alone or a JSON object with `access_token`. It is read immediately before a native request so the operator can refresh the same user's credentials. Token content is excluded from source editions, request records, browser storage and archives.

The profile's native API origin is exact. Pagination stays inside the same selected HTTPS API root. Native user, organization or CSDL changes require a new reviewed target plan; a resumed operation cannot silently switch environments.

The selected IANA source time zone converts native local dates to UTC. A local time in a daylight-saving gap is rejected. An ambiguous repeated local time requires an explicit fold selection. Date choices are recorded in the prepared mapping.

### Map the actual source

The browser initially maps:

| Original source field | Native task field | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | `msdyn_subject` | Text |
| `START` | `msdyn_scheduledstart` | Local date/time to UTC |
| `FINISH` | `msdyn_scheduledend` | Local date/time to UTC |

Additional task fields must name an actual scalar field in the retained native CSDL. The migration manages identity, project/bucket/parent links and calculated work fields separately. Each selected conversion is explicit: text, UTC date/time, integer, finite exact JSON number, percentage-to-fraction, boolean or native choice.

For a UTC mapping, enter an IANA zone such as `America/Chicago` in its option field, or a JSON object with `timezone` and an explicit `fold`. For a native choice mapping, enter an object mapping each exact source value to the selected native integer option.

Dependency mappings use the original source relation value as the key and an option from the **actual native dependency choices** as the value. Read both the original dependency family and the probe before selecting it. Resource mappings are keyed by the exact original source row key and name an existing native project-team GUID. Unmapped resources receive explicitly prepared generic project-team records; rates, work calendars and historical costs remain in the original source and receiving comparison.

The additional mapping JSON can provide `resource_names`, `assignment_names`, `date_decisions` and the other named planner options. The compiler rejects unknown mapping options and collisions instead of silently interpreting them.

## Review and native execution

A prepared native plan retains:

- The exact original edition and source hashes.
- Selected user, organization, native CSDL and target profile.
- Every deterministic prepared native record GUID.
- Source-to-target field conversions and parent, assignment and dependency links.
- Immediate project/team actions.
- The full ordered native OperationSets and their individual transaction boundaries.
- Original source values retained outside this target write.
- A content hash for the complete plan.

The browser requires the named reviewer to acknowledge each listed source-retention and transaction decision. The saved review is bound to that exact plan.

Project/team creation is immediate in the documented native API. Each subsequent OperationSet is a separate transaction, with at most 200 selected operations. An earlier completed set remains completed if a later set fails. The browser shows those actual states separately.

The operator invokes the documented actions through their actual CSDL parameter names:

| Purpose | Native action |
| --- | --- |
| Create the selected project | `msdyn_CreateProjectV1` |
| Create a project-team member | `msdyn_CreateTeamMemberV1` |
| Open the original native transaction | `msdyn_CreateOperationSetV1` |
| Queue original created rows | `msdyn_PssCreateV1` |
| Queue reviewed task corrections | `msdyn_PssUpdateV1` |
| Execute the original transaction | `msdyn_ExecuteOperationSetV1` |
| Abandon an unexecuted native set | `msdyn_AbandonOperationSetV1` |

The low-level transport also validates the documented delete and assignment-contour action contracts for composition by an explicitly reviewed plan. This operator's creation and following task-correction plans emit only their declared actions.

### Interrupted responses

Before each native write, the original request is stored and its invocation is durably recorded. Every complete returned native body, status, relevant headers and SHA is retained before interpretation.

A lost native reply leaves that exact call uncertain. Reopening does the following:

- Project or team creation: read the exact prepared native GUID and compare the submitted fields and project links.
- OperationSet creation: read the complete native collection for the original project, exact saved description and user, requiring one matching set.
- Queued row: retain the complete original OperationSet details. The operator can inspect the actual request and selected native detail together, then retain a named review of their exact match.
- Execution: read the **same** native OperationSet until its actual status resolves.
- Abandonment: read that original set's actual abandoned state.

An uncertain native POST is never automatically repeated. The actual serialized `OperationSetResponse` must name the original set and row. One native detail cannot acknowledge two different local row calls.

A known rejected call retains its exact response. Explicit retry stays on the original input and obeys any retained native `Retry-After` floor. The **Pause** control saves a local intent; an active native response is retained before the next write is considered. Closing the desk also stops later native dispatch after the current response is retained.

An unexecuted set can be abandoned with an explicit operator/reason. The original execution cannot be abandoned through this control after its submission has become accepted or uncertain; its native state is reconciled first.

### Following task corrections

After the original migration completes, select its saved deployment and a corrected source edition. **Prepare following native task correction** creates another reviewed operation on the same project and native task GUIDs.

This mode preserves the original task, resource, assignment and dependency row identities, hierarchy and relationship selections. It groups changed mapped fields into one native update for each original task. Actual current native values, record identity and observed ETag are captured before review. Values already equal to the intended correction are retained as such and produce no write.

Before queuing a changed row and again before executing its set, the operator reads the original native values and checks them against the reviewed before values. The documented scheduling action has no conditional ETag parameter. Coordinate concurrent edits to the selected target fields during this operation; the saved review states this exact API boundary.

If a field changes after review, the original set remains unexecuted. Review that current native value, abandon the original unexecuted set when appropriate, and prepare a new correction. The previous source edition, target state, queued calls and receiving comparison remain available.

## Actual receiving, comparison and acceptance

Cloud receiving uses the original pinned `org.mpxj.msplanner.MsPlannerReader` against the selected environment and project. Its private local read transport supplies the original reader requests from complete actual Dataverse responses. The source parser, calendars, assignment logic and native project writer remain the original MPXJ implementation.

The transport retains each provider page with its original URL, response bytes and retrieval time. It follows top-level page cursors and expanded collections. Dataverse single-level expansion links identify the complete relationship collection, so that collection replaces the inline view before its pages are followed. A link carrying a real paging cursor continues the original array. The original inline view and complete collection are both retained. Paging is a sequence of actual reads; its recorded interval remains visible.

The completed JSON delivered to MPXJ, the first accepted target probe and the read manifest are pinned to the original capture request. An interrupted capture reuses retained pages. Closing the reader or host stops further page assembly while preserving the original complete pages already received. After the reader completes, its local continuation can reopen from those saved pages without another provider read. The original `PortfolioWorkspace.capture_native` retains the actual native project and reopens its completed edition under the same request. This source closure is included in the portable workspace.

Task and assignment GUIDs map directly to exact captured rows. Project-team resources join through the actual assignment's bookable-resource lookup, which is the GUID used by this reader. A dependency joins its actual native record to captured task GUIDs, native relation type and exact reader lag. A resource omitted by the original reader, an unsupported native field, or competing identities produces a visible finding.

Cloud comparison calls the source engine with `strict_identity=True`: explicit original-key maps and unique GUID matches pair rows. Captured task UIDs resolve relationships only within that captured model. The comparison preserves unresolved identities and all original differences for acceptance.

The local reader uses its pinned v9.2 path convention; the transport retains and uses the exact API version selected in the private target profile. Response and collection limits fail visibly when a complete result exceeds the selected capacity. They do not publish a truncated capture.

File receiving uses the actual uploaded project and the source engine's ordinary same-format identity rules, with an optional exact per-family identity map.

Acceptance binds the original intended source edition, current captured target, exact comparison and target review. It records the accepting operator, decision note and each retained difference. A later target capture produces a new comparison and clears that current acceptance.

The handover provides:

- A readable HTML record of the selected target, original sources, native transaction results and the current acceptance.
- The complete JSON handover with original record identities and comparison.
- A portable workspace containing source bytes, editions, requests and replies, review, correction history, target capture and acceptance.

## Same-request browser and CLI recovery

The browser saves the exact request ID and arguments **before** POST. If the reply is interrupted or local sign-in expires, it keeps that original request. **Resume saved request** reads or resumes the same server-side action. A completed or failed saved action stays in Activity. An explicit retry of a failed local action retains its original input and prior failure record; the native journal still reconciles the original provider calls. A request can be discarded as unsent only after an authenticated read confirms that its original local record is absent.

A server restart does not silently launch old native work. Open Activity or use the CLI to resume a selected retained local request. The native journal still reconciles every prior provider invocation before a further write.

```sh
python operator/cli.py --workspace /absolute/customer/portfolio-workspace state
python operator/cli.py --workspace /absolute/customer/portfolio-workspace upload /absolute/source/project.mpp
python operator/cli.py --workspace /absolute/customer/portfolio-workspace \
  action intake --arguments-file /absolute/private/intake.json
python operator/cli.py --workspace /absolute/customer/portfolio-workspace \
  request ORIGINAL_64_HEX_REQUEST_ID --resume
python operator/cli.py --workspace /absolute/customer/portfolio-workspace \
  deployment ORIGINAL_64_HEX_DEPLOYMENT_ID
```

The `upload` result is the exact `source` object for `intake`:

```json
{
  "source": {
```

"""Run the original portfolio source/target desk and receive its complete archive.

This is one retained receiving operation. Source intake, correction, MSPDI
writing, comparison and portable receiving use the original PortfolioWorkspace.
No Project Operations service is imitated by this file-target journey.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fcntl
import inspect
from contextlib import contextmanager
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SERVICE = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(SERVICE))
sys.path.insert(0, str(SERVICE / "operator"))

from portfolio import PortfolioWorkspace
from portfolio_target import TargetWorkspace, start_desk
from portfolio_target.target import canonical, utcnow
from portfolio_target.storage import write_bytes

SCHEMA = "portfolio.operator-native-receiving.v1"


def sha_file(path):
    count, result = 0, hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as source:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            count += len(chunk)
            result.update(chunk)
    return {"bytes": count, "sha256": result.hexdigest()}


def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def save_json(path, value):
    write_bytes(Path(path), canonical(value))


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def verify_artifacts(result):
    for item in result["artifacts"]:
        actual = sha_file(item["path"])
        require(actual["sha256"] == item["sha256"] and actual["bytes"] == item["bytes"],
                "A retained completed artifact changed: " + item["path"])
    return result


def retain_source(source, destination):
    source = Path(source).resolve(strict=True)
    before = source.stat()
    expected = sha_file(source)
    after = source.stat()
    require((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
            (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns),
            "The selected original fixture changed during intake.")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    if destination.exists():
        require(sha_file(destination) == expected, "The original retained fixture differs.")
        return expected
    temporary = destination.with_name("." + destination.name + ".receiving")
    with open(source, "rb") as incoming, open(temporary, "wb") as output:
        shutil.copyfileobj(incoming, output, length=1024 * 1024)
        output.flush()
        os.fsync(output.fileno())
    require(sha_file(temporary) == expected, "The original fixture copy is incomplete.")
    try:
        os.link(temporary, destination)
    except FileExistsError:
        require(sha_file(destination) == expected, "The retained fixture destination changed.")
    finally:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    os.chmod(destination, 0o600)
    return expected


@contextmanager
def running_desk(workspace, native):
    desk = start_desk(workspace, native=native, port=0)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=desk.server.serve_forever,
                              kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.25}, name="portfolio-native-receiving-http")
    thread.start()
    try:
        yield desk
    finally:
        desk.close()
        thread.join()


def browser_receive(desk, entry, *, node, browser_directory, directory):
    private = Path(directory) / "browser-entry.json"
    value = {**entry, "url": desk.origin + "/#token=" + desk.token,
             "browser_directory": str(browser_directory)}
    save_json(private, value)
    try:
        result = subprocess.run([str(node), str(HERE / "browser.mjs"), str(private)],
                                cwd=SERVICE, check=False)
        require(result.returncode == 0,
                "The original browser receiving is retained in browser-progress.json; exit " + str(result.returncode))
        return verify_artifacts(read_json(Path(entry["output"]) / "browser-result.json"))
    finally:
        private.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def _receive(directory, source_path, output, *, node, playwright, chromium,
            operation_id="SENSEI-PORTFOLIO-TARGET-RECEIVING-20261012-B9D2-V1",
            native=None, review_decisions=None, reviewer="Original source receiving operator",
            resume_failed=False):
    directory, output = Path(directory).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    require(directory != output and directory not in output.parents,
            "Keep receiving outputs outside the selected business workspace.")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    os.chmod(output, 0o700)
    result_path = output / "result.json"
    source_path = Path(source_path).resolve()
    source_copy = output / "selected-input" / source_path.name
    saved_input = source_copy.with_name(source_copy.name + ".retained")
    intent_path = output / "operation.json"
    selected = source_path if source_path.is_file() else (
        source_copy if source_copy.is_file() else saved_input if intent_path.exists() and saved_input.is_file() else None)
    require(selected is not None, "Reopen the original selected fixture or its retained input bytes.")
    source_metadata = sha_file(selected)
    control = {"schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": operation_id, "workspace": str(directory),
               "source_sha256": source_metadata["sha256"], "source_bytes": source_metadata["bytes"],
               "source_filename": source_path.name, "review_decisions": review_decisions or {},
               "reviewer": reviewer}
    if intent_path.exists():
        previous = read_json(intent_path)
        require(previous["input"] == control, "Resume this exact original receiving operation and selected source.")
    else:
        save_json(intent_path, {"input": control, "created_at": utcnow()})
    if result_path.exists():
        return verify_artifacts(read_json(result_path))
    retain_source(selected, source_copy)
    workspace = TargetWorkspace(directory, native=native)
    native = workspace.portfolio.native
    runtime = native.ensure()
    save_json(output / "native-runtime.json", runtime)
    manifest = read_json(SERVICE / "operator" / "source-manifest.json")
    require(manifest["schema"] == "portfolio.operator-source.v1", "Use the complete selected operator source manifest.")
    source_selection = {"schema": "portfolio.operator-receiving-source.v1",
                        "operation_id": operation_id, "files": []}
    for selected_file in manifest["files"]:
        file = (SERVICE / "operator" / selected_file["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        require((SERVICE / "operator").resolve() in file.parents, "An operator source entry leaves its original subtree.")
        actual = sha_file(file)
        require(actual["sha256"] == selected_file["sha256"] and actual["bytes"] == selected_file["bytes"],
                "The selected operator source differs from its complete manifest: " + selected_file["path"])
        source_selection["files"].append({"path": str(file.relative_to(SERVICE)), **actual})
    original_package = Path(inspect.getfile(PortfolioWorkspace)).resolve().parent
    for file in sorted(original_package.glob("*.py")):
        source_selection["files"].append({"path": "portfolio/" + file.name, **sha_file(file)})
    selection_path = output / "source-selection.json"
    if selection_path.exists():
        previous = read_json(selection_path)
        if previous != source_selection:
            history = read_json(output / "source-selection-history.json") if (output / "source-selection-history.json").exists() else []
            history.append(previous)
            save_json(output / "source-selection-history.json", history)
    save_json(selection_path, source_selection)
    entry = {
        "operation_id": operation_id, "source": str(source_copy),
        "source_sha256": source_metadata["sha256"], "source_label": source_path.name,
        "playwright": str(Path(playwright).resolve(strict=True)),
        "chromium": str(Path(chromium).resolve(strict=True)),
        "reviewer": reviewer, "review_decisions": review_decisions or {},
        "resume_failed": bool(resume_failed),
    }
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="portfolio-receiving-", dir="/dev") as browser_root:
        with running_desk(directory, native) as desk:
            original = browser_receive(desk, {**entry, "phase": "original", "output": str(output / "original")},
                node=Path(node).resolve(strict=True), browser_directory=Path(browser_root) / "original", directory=output)
        archive = Path(original["archive"]["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        require(sha_file(archive) == {key: original["archive"][key] for key in ("sha256", "bytes")},
                "The complete original workspace archive changed.")
        restored = output / "received-workspace"
        restore_intent = {"schema": "portfolio.operator-receiving-restore.v1",
                          "operation_id": operation_id, "archive_sha256": original["archive"]["sha256"],
                          "archive_bytes": original["archive"]["bytes"], "destination": str(restored)}
        restore_intent_path, restore_receipt_path = output / "restore-intent.json", output / "restore-receipt.json"
        if restore_intent_path.exists():
            require(read_json(restore_intent_path) == restore_intent, "Keep the original cold-restore destination.")
        else:
            save_json(restore_intent_path, restore_intent)
        # Only our private selected-input copy is moved. The original upstream
        # fixture remains untouched, and the complete copied bytes are retained.
        saved_input = source_copy.with_name(source_copy.name + ".retained")
        if source_copy.exists():
            if saved_input.exists():
                require(sha_file(saved_input) == source_metadata, "The saved original input differs.")
                source_copy.unlink()
            else:
                source_copy.rename(saved_input)
        require(not source_copy.exists() and sha_file(saved_input) == source_metadata,
                "The source-absent receiving boundary did not preserve the original bytes.")
        if restore_receipt_path.exists():
            restore_receipt = read_json(restore_receipt_path)
        else:
            restore_receipt = PortfolioWorkspace.receive_workspace(archive, restored)
            save_json(restore_receipt_path, restore_receipt)
        received = TargetWorkspace(restored, native=native)
        actual = received.deployment(original["deployment_id"])
        require(actual["state"] == "ACCEPTED" and actual["acceptance_sha256"] == original["acceptance_sha256"],
                "The actual cold-restored workspace did not preserve the original target acceptance.")
        for request_id in original["original_request_ids"][:-1]:
            retained = received.request_result(request_id)
            require(retained["state"] == "COMPLETE",
                    "An original completed business action was not retained by the workspace archive.")
        with running_desk(restored, native) as desk:
            reopened = browser_receive(desk, {**entry, "phase": "restored", "original": original,
                "output": str(output / "restored-browser")},
                node=Path(node).resolve(strict=True), browser_directory=Path(browser_root) / "restored", directory=output)
    artifacts = [*original["artifacts"], *reopened["artifacts"]]
    for name in ("native-runtime.json", "source-selection.json", "restore-receipt.json"):
        path = output / name
        artifacts.append({"path": str(path), "filename": name, **sha_file(path)})
    result = {
        "schema": "portfolio.operator-native-receiving-result.v1", "operation_id": operation_id,
        "state": "COMPLETE", "source_fixture": source_metadata, "native_runtime": runtime,
        "original": original, "restored": reopened,
        "source_absent_receiving": {"selected_input": str(source_copy), "retained_bytes": str(saved_input),
                                    "archive_sha256": original["archive"]["sha256"]},
        "restore": restore_receipt, "artifacts": artifacts, "completed_at": utcnow(),
    }
    save_json(result_path, result)
    return verify_artifacts(result)


def receive(directory, source_path, output, **options):
    """Join one exact retained operation; another live receiver keeps its lease."""
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    with open(output / ".receiving.lock", "a+b") as lease:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(lease.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError as exc:
            raise ValueError("The original receiving operation is already active.") from exc
        try:
            return _receive(directory, source_path, output, **options)
        finally:
            fcntl.flock(lease.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Receive one original source-native portfolio migration through its complete target desk.")
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source", required=True, help="Selected exact upstream project fixture or authorized project file.")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--operation-id", default="SENSEI-PORTFOLIO-TARGET-RECEIVING-20261012-B9D2-V1")
    parser.add_argument("--node", default="/opt/codex/runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node")
    parser.add_argument("--playwright", default="/opt/codex/runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs")
    parser.add_argument("--chromium", required=True, help="Actual existing Chromium executable.")
    parser.add_argument("--review-decisions", help="Exact original finding decisions JSON, if the selected source requires them.")
    parser.add_argument("--reviewer", default="Original source receiving operator")
    parser.add_argument("--resume-failed", action="store_true", help="Reopen the same failed local request after its source correction.")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    result = receive(args.workspace, args.source, args.output, node=args.node, playwright=args.playwright,
                     chromium=args.chromium, operation_id=args.operation_id, reviewer=args.reviewer,
                     review_decisions=read_json(args.review_decisions) if args.review_decisions else None,
                     resume_failed=args.resume_failed)
    print(json.dumps({"state": result["state"], "operation_id": result["operation_id"],
                      "result_file": str(Path(args.output).resolve() / "result.json"),
                      "archive_sha256": result["original"]["archive"]["sha256"],
                      "acceptance_sha256": result["original"]["acceptance_sha256"]}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
